scope: One fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster. The case compares admission of one synthetic 600m CPU / 128Mi Pod request before and after an ordinary 500m CPU / 256Mi memory namespace ResourceQuota, verifies a low-request Pod remains admissible, and checks projected ServiceAccount authorization for creating Pods and ResourceQuota objects. A synthetic platform identity gets only ResourceQuota create permission. A pinned Kueue v0.17.7 controller also compares held and admitted two-Pod batches against a local queue's nominal CPU quota and checks queue-admin authorization. Its readiness timeout also releases a reserved batch when one of two workers remains unready. Volcano and production fairness, priority, preemption and accelerator quotas require separate evidence.

Without a namespace quota, the 600m synthetic request is admitted
Tenant ServiceAccount cannot create a ResourceQuota
